text: Leave the grid's empty squares under chosen keyword letters; shuffle the letters inside each row by the keyword; copy out a few diagonals before the columns. Each needs only a keyword.
Every rule for 181,308 keywords (and K1-K3 passages as keys for rows wider than 24), both directions, with a repeating key of 1-26 on the sculpture's tables after or before.
The shortest key that fits K4 is as long as on the copies in all three, and K4 leads the copies in at most two cells. Closed.
